column1: # The release budget of each family (tools/gate_class.py reads it; `gate_class.py check` holds the rule, `budget` prints the table).
#   family    a row of tools/families.tsv; a family with no row is red (`python3 tools/gate_class.py budget --refresh` adds it)
#   real_s    seconds: the sum, over the family's real-tier gates, of the median of each gate's last five real-tier rows in gate-times.tsv.
#            A family's real-tier gates are the recipes a real-tier batch runs unattended, whether its tier is main or other; a by-hand
#            gate (tools/ref/needs-env.sh) is none. Measured, and written only by `gate_class.py budget --refresh` on the machine that
#            holds gate-times.tsv (CI has none): run it when a gate is added, cut or reshaped, and after a release batch
#   unrowed   how many of those gates have no real-tier row yet. They are in no real_s (a gate no batch has timed is not a number);
#            `release-list --wall` prices each at 45 s, and a family with any is under-counted here until its real tier has run
#   budget_s  the most real_s may reach: 300 unless the row has a `budget` waiver. A budget moves down when a cut makes it reachable and
#            up only with a dated reason
#   waivers   `-`, or entries `rule=PIN(YYYY-MM-DD): reason` joined by ` | `. The rules, each the exception to one line of AGENTS.md's
#            "A new model adds the least to every later release":
#              budget   budget_s over 300. A grandfather row is the day's real_s plus a fifth for the run-to-run spread, to the next 10 s
#              ship     more than one +ship gate (a family's serve gate is the one that blocks a release)
#              main     tier main: the maintainer's call, which the reason names
#              fixture  families.tsv fixture no on a family with gates. It grandfathers a family that predates the rule (2026-11-14), so a
#                       waiver dated after that day is refused: a newer family has a fixture row
#            A waiver nothing needs any more is a note of `check`; drop it.
